overview: Alterations in leases refer to physical changes or renovations made by a tenant to a leased premises, typically requiring prior landlord consent via a License to Alter. Clauses range from absolute prohibitions to qualified permission for internal, non-structural works.
preliminary: OTHER LEASE CLAUSES – MASTER ABSTRACTION GUIDE

(Allowance | Alteration | Assignment and Subletting| Casualty| Condemnation | Hazardous Materials | Holdover | Landlord Restriction | Monetary Default | Non – Monetary Default | Parking | Repair and Maintenance | Reporting of Financial Information | Reporting of Gross Sales | Sublease Provision | Subordination)
